inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.subsection: Public Health Sciences — Epidemiology and Biostatistics
inventory.visualPurpose: The Clinical therapeutic trial phase pipeline figure (book 257 upper): the drug development rail — Preclinical → Phase 0 (microdosing, often skipped) → Phase 1 (Safety, dose escalation, maximum tolerable dose) → Phase 2 (does it Work? efficacy, short-term adverse effects) → Phase 3 (any Improvement? effectiveness vs current standard of care/placebo) → FDA approval → Phase 4 (can it stay on the Market? postmarketing surveillance) — with the printed Sample row (very small / small / moderate / large / surveillance; open label vs randomized, controlled, anonymized) beneath
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE-VECTOR FLOW FIGURE, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; VLM-read at 120dpi, staging-pubh2/vlm-census.txt — VLM available this session): six illustrated station boxes in a horizontal row left to right — Preclinical (microscope icon, 'Test drug in lab animals and in vitro experiments'), Phase 0 (green distribution-curve icon, 'Initial pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic assessment via microdosing. Often skipped.'), Phase 1 (syringe icon, 'Safety assessment via dose escalation. Determine maximum tolerable dose.'), Phase 2 (heart/stethoscope icon, 'Efficacy assessment (does it Work?) Provides additional data on short-term adverse effects.' — 'Work?' in red), Phase 3 (scales icon, 'Effectiveness assessment via comparison with current standard of care/placebo (any Improvement?)' — 'Improvement?' in red), Phase 4 (pill-bottle icon, 'Provides data on long-term or rare adverse effects (can it stay on the Market?)' — 'Market?' in red) — joined by left-to-right gray arrows, with the 'FDA approval' label ABOVE the connector between Phase 3 and Phase 4; beneath, a 'Sample' row with per-phase person-group icons (green under Phase 0, light blue under Phase 1, pink under Phase 2 + a large pink '?', purple under Phase 3 + a large purple '?', tan under Phase 4) and the printed sample texts 'Very small number of healthy volunteers or patients with disease of interest. Open label.' (Phase 0) / 'Small number…' (Phase 1) / 'Moderate number of patients with disease of interest. Randomized, controlled, anonymized.' (Phase 2) / 'Large number…' (Phase 3) / 'Postmarketing surveillance of patients with disease of interest. Open label.' (Phase 4); 'Randomized' italicized in the phase 2/3 captions. The mnemonic 'Can I SWIM?' prints in the body sentence above the figure ('Can' bold navy, 'I SWIM' bold red), not as letters over the boxes.
inventory.kypLocation: the whole registry visual (ClinicalTrialsMap in visuals/pubhealth-p2.tsx): the design-quality ladder strip (experimental in humans → randomized → controlled → double-blinded → triple-blind, each rung with its bias channel); the six-station pipeline rail with First Aid's own SWIM letter badges pinned to phases 1-4 (S Safety, W Work, I Improvement, M Market — attributed) and the FDA approval gate above the Phase 3→4 connector; the printed Sample row rebuilt with headcount figures (1/3/5/8/9), open-label vs randomized-controlled-anonymized chips, and the two large '?' anonymization badges beside phases 2-3; the analysis-population fork (intention-to-treat vs as-treated vs per-protocol with the printed bias ratings and the dilution trade); the crossover timeline (subject → treatment A → washout → treatment B → subject = own control). Every printed label and caption is ALSO carried verbatim in the note's table block (blocks[1]), core.what, the list block (blocks[2]), and recall[0-7]
